1.1:
#eObtaining Cores#n
1. Randomly given for completing training programs.
2. Chance to drop from system monsters.
3. Sold by #p9075110#.
(Complete Links or hunt system monsters to obtain Evolving Coins.)
1.2:
Equip Cores in the Evolution System window to modify your Virtual World. 
#eCore Rules#n1. Cores can only be equipped on slots of the same shape.
(Round Cores can only be equipped in round slots.)
2. Cores with similar effects cannot be stacked.
(The 10% Drop Boost Core cannot be equipped with a 20% Drop Boost Core.)
#eEquipping Cores#n1. Double-click on a Core in Core Storage, or drag the Cores into a slot.
#eUnequipping Cores#n1. Double-click on an equipped Core, or drag the Core into the Storage window.
#eDestroying Cores#n1. Drag a Core outside of the Evolution System window to permanently destroy it.
1.3: Equip Cores to change the Evolution System virtual environment.\r\nCore tutorial concluding.
